prose: Author and esoteric researcher Jason Quitt joins Vibe Rant tonight. In his previous appearances on InnerVerse, we discussed his two books, Egyptian Postures of Power and Astral Genesis. In classic Vibe Rant style, we'll be blessed to witness the first time mind-meld between Jason, Slick Dissident, and fan-favorite regular, Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies. What we discuss is up to the fates, but given that we've just passed through the gate of judgement (Libra & the Equinox), this cast is likely to include some deep analysis of underworld symbolism as it shows up in the Egyptian mythos.
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
